# Leteski

> Leteski is a peer-to-peer skill exchange platform and live learning marketplace where people teach what they know and learn what they don't — exchanging skills, attending live group classes, and building community.

## Core Features & Navigation
- [Home](https://leteski.com/): Peer-to-peer skill exchange marketplace homepage.
- [Explore Skills](https://leteski.com/explore): Search and browse community mentors, topics, and skill swaps.
- [Live Classes](https://leteski.com/classes): Interactive group courses, single workshops, and recurring classes.
- [Resource Library](https://leteski.com/resources): Curated articles, video tutorials, guides, and learning documents.
- [Skill Swaps](https://leteski.com/swaps): 1-on-1 swap management, scheduling, video calls, and barter history.

## Information & Policies
- [About Us](https://leteski.com/about): Our mission, platform model, and peer-to-peer learning philosophy.
- [Terms of Service](https://leteski.com/terms): Guidelines, credit economy rules, and terms of service.
- [Privacy Policy](https://leteski.com/privacy): User privacy, security practices, and data protection policy.
- [Help & Support](https://leteski.com/help): FAQ, support contact, and dispute resolution.
- [Contact Us](https://leteski.com/contact): Reach out to the Leteski team for inquiries and assistance.
